highest_risk_sinks.evidence: HomeController::doInstall() reads `.env.example` (188), replaces `{key}` placeholders for EVERY request key (`foreach ($postData as $key => $item)`, 194-200), then `file_put_contents($envPath, $envTemp, LOCK_EX)` (202) and `file_put_contents($installLock, 'install ok', LOCK_EX)` (216).
highest_risk_sinks.observed_guard: CRLF guard at 138-145 (test at 142) iterates a fixed whitelist (`db_host`, `db_port`, `db_database`, `db_username`, `db_password`, `redis_host`, `redis_password`, `redis_port`, `title`, `app_url`, `admin_path`) and tests `preg_match('/[\r\n]/', (string) $request->input($field))`.
highest_risk_sinks.guard_gap_hypothesis: The guard casts each value with `(string)`. A request that submits a whitelisted key as an ARRAY (e.g. `db_host[]=...`) makes `(string)` produce `Array`, so the CRLF test cannot match, while the write loop skips escaping because `is_string($item)` is false (195-197) and `str_replace('{db_host}', $item, ...)` is still executed with the array (200). Net effect to be confirmed in triage: CRLF/newline content could reach the generated .env.
highest_risk_sinks.placeholder_surface_checked: All `.env.example` placeholders ({APP_NAME},{admin_path},{app_key},{app_url},{db_*},{redis_*},{title}) are covered by the whitelist or generated server-side (app_key, 191-193), so no extra uncontrolled placeholder exists today.
highest_risk_sinks.status: reported for triage; reachability and exploitability NOT classified in this phase

highest_risk_sinks.sink_type: SSRF (tool category: LFI, because the call is file_get_contents)
highest_risk_sinks.risk_theme: server-side request to a stored, operator-controlled URL
highest_risk_sinks.evidence: api_hook is a data value of the `goods` record (`$goodInfo->api_hook`), editable in the admin form `$form->textarea('api_hook')` at app/Admin/Controllers/GoodsController.php:155, and rendered with `->unescape()` at GoodsController.php:123. No scheme/host/IP allowlist is applied before the request at ApiHook.php:85.
highest_risk_sinks.status: reported for triage (second-order / stored source); reachability NOT classified

highest_risk_sinks.evidence: Host is hardcoded to sctapi.ftqq.com; only the path segment `$apiToken` comes from `dujiaoka_config_get('server_jiang_token')` (69). Body is POSTed via a stream context built at 61-68.

highest_risk_sinks.risk_theme: raw SQL fragments in admin dashboard charts
highest_risk_sinks.evidence: All five DB::raw occurrences in the app scope receive string literals only: `'DATE(created_at) as date'`, `'count(id) as num'`, `'sum(actual_price) as actual_price'` (arg_safety = safe in every case).
highest_risk_sinks.status: inventory entry; no user-controllable argument observed in this phase

highest_risk_sinks.risk_theme: MD5 used for payment-gateway request/notification signatures
highest_risk_sinks.evidence: Signature construction pattern `$sign = md5($sign . $this->payGateway->merchant_pem)` (e.g. YipayController.php:41) and verification `$expectedSign = md5($sign . $payGateway->merchant_pem)` (YipayController.php:94). Per anti_hallucination.md Rule 14, MD5 is only a vulnerability when used for password storage or signature verification with practical exploitability; these are signature usages and are therefore candidates for the crypto auditor, not automatic findings. Comparison is delegated to `PayController::secureCompare()` (app/Http/Controllers/PayController.php:123) for all 8 callers listed by grep.
highest_risk_sinks.status: flagged for crypto_auditor triage (constant-time compare implementation and secret strength are out of scope for recon)

highest_risk_sinks.risk_theme: local file read of application-managed paths
highest_risk_sinks.evidence: `$envExamplePath = base_path().'/.env.example'` (184) and `$installSql = database_path().'/sql/install.sql'` (187) are both derived from `base_path()`/`database_path()`, not from request data; `DB::unprepared(file_get_contents($installSql))` at 204. app/Http/Controllers/Pay/CoinbaseController.php:83 reads `php://input` (safe literal).
highest_risk_sinks.status: inventory entry; no user-controllable path observed in this phase

highest_risk_sinks.evidence: CoinbaseController.php:21 sets `$createOrderUrl="https://api.commerce.coinbase.com/charges"` and passes it to `curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, ...)` at 53; GeetestLib builds `http://api.geetest.com/register.php?...` (83) and `http://api.geetest.com/validate.php` (167) before calling sendRequest/postRequest (221, 260). Hosts are hardcoded constants, so these are not attacker-selectable destinations at this stage.
highest_risk_sinks.status: inventory entry; destination not user-controllable as far as static reading shows

false_positive_candidates_identified.reason: The call is `$this->load(__DIR__.'/Commands')` — Laravel's console command loader, not `DOMDocument::load()`. The tool matches method name `load` case-insensitively by name only. Not an XML parser call.

false_positive_candidates_identified.lines: SecurityHeaders.php:13, ForceAdminPasswordChange.php:17,29,47, DujiaoSystem.php:29, PayGateWay.php:19, InstallCheck.php:23, RedirectIfAuthenticated.php:25, DujiaoBoot.php:54
false_positive_candidates_identified.reason: `$next($request)` is the standard Laravel middleware pipeline closure, whose value is supplied by the framework router, not by request data.
First argument is the literal string `'trim'` (arg_safety = safe); only the second (the array being trimmed) is dynamic.
Patterns are literal, fixed regexes (`/\t/`, `/\r\n/`, `/\r/`, `/\n/`, `/ /`, `/  /`) with empty replacement and no `/e` modifier. PHP 8 removed `/e` entirely.

review_notes.reachability: NOT classified in this artifact. Per task instruction, priority/route/auth mapping belongs to the triage/audit phase; this file is a sink inventory plus risk pointers only.
coverage_limits: Sinks are function/method-name based (AST scan). Dynamic dispatch through containers, Blade/PHP source-string builds (`Route::view`, `eval`-like wrappers) and raw SQL built by string concatenation inside query builders are not all visible.
Template-level XSS output points (Blade `{!! !!}`) are not part of this tool's scope; the tool only reports printf/vprintf.
`vendor/`, `node_modules/` and `.git/` are excluded by the tool.
`app/` scan is the application surface; `tools/php-audit-skills/tools/*` results are audit tooling and are recorded separately, never as application findings.
No dynamic verification was performed in this phase (static recon only); no payloads were sent.
handoff: Phase-3 trace should start from SK-001 (HomeController::doInstall -> file_put_contents, includes DB::unprepared of install.sql) and SK-002 (goods.api_hook -> file_get_contents).
Crypto sinks (SK-005) need the crypto_auditor to read `PayController::secureCompare()` (app/Http/Controllers/PayController.php:123) and each gateway's secret source before any severity is assigned.
Middleware `$next()` and `$this->load()` hits should be filtered out early by context_extractor to avoid wasting trace budget.
No NoSQL/GraphQL/LDAP/WordPress sinks were produced by the app-scope scan.
